params.title: Act I: The Entry
params.text: The end of the long nightmare is in sight. 1,500 more monster souls, and the contract is fulfilled. Reclaim your freedom!!

params.title: A Dying Villager
params.text: The creatures... they came from the rift. The Shepherd said he would protect us... he lied. Run, stranger. This forest devours all who linger.

params.title: The Scythe Whispers
params.text: You feel the Umbral Scythe pulling at your soul with every swing. The dark steel hums with satisfaction. Something is wrong... but the contract must be fulfilled.

params.title: WARNING: Gatekeeper Territory
params.text: The trees twist and blacken ahead. A demonic presence drives the monsters into a frenzy here. The Gatekeeper is near. Prepare yourself, Kaelen.

params.title: The Fabricator Watches
params.text: You feel eyes upon you from beyond the veil. 'Closer, closer,' a silken voice hisses. 'Every soul you reap binds you tighter to my design.' The contract burns in your chest.

params.title: The Scythe Speaks
params.text: The blade thrums with dark energy. 'One more. Just one more, and you will be free...' But something in its tone feels wrong. Like a predator soothing its prey before the final strike.
